title: AI-Powered RPG Demo now with material generation and v2 of item crafting
author: Lemon30
selftext:
Hi!

Play the [demo](https://battle-die-repeat.flutterflow.app). Here you can find the version 2 of the AI-Powered item crafting demo of my side-project RPG: [Battle, Die, Repeat!](http://battledierepeat.com).

  
You can find my [previous post](https://www.reddit.com/r/ChatGPTGaming/comments/1ecylxc/aipowered_rpg_item_crafting_demo/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web3x&utm_name=web3xcss&utm_term=1&utm_content=share_button) here.

  
There are some major changes and I'd like to get feedback on this version. I wanted to address the balance issues from the first version and introduce some multiplayer elements.

Also, where should I go from here? Do you guys have any ideas on how we can have an AI-powered battle mechanic?  


Changes:

>- \[UPDATE\] The input materials are no longer free-text. You have to pick two materials from a list of materials as input.

>- \[NEW\] Material generation.

>- You can now generate materials through AI.

>- Give a material description and a new material will be added to the list of crafting materials.

>- The crafting materials are shared by all users which means that if you generate a material other users will be able to use it as well.

>- \[NEW\] Item images.

>- Now you can generate images for your crafted items.

Plans for v3:

* Allow items as input for item crafting alongside materials.
* Allow more than just two inputs in crafting.
* Save generated items and images in user's inventory.
* Add material search and list by crafted date.
